author_or_org: Hüseyin Özgür Kamalı, Erdem Tuna, Vahid Haratian, Eray Tüzün

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: AI coding assistants increase code production velocity while expanding the volume of code requiring review, making code review a growing bottleneck.
claims.quote: The rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) coding assistants has intensified this challenge: while these tools increase code production velocity, they also expand the volume of code requiring review, turning code review into a growing bottleneck.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Current AI support for code review is fragmented across isolated tasks such as reviewer recommendation, PR description generation, and comment suggestion rather than supporting the end-to-end PR review workflow.
claims.quote: Current AI support in code review remains fragmented, with tools focusing on isolated tasks such as reviewer recommendation, PR description generation, or comment suggestion rather than the end-to-end PR review workflow.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The proposed review framework spans five stages: PR Creation, PR Augmentation, Reviewer Selection, AI-Assisted Code Review, and PR Retrospective, retaining humans at key decision points.
claims.quote: Our framework spans five stages: PR Creation, PR Augmentation, Reviewer Selection, AI-Assisted Code Review, and PR Retrospective, with humans retained at key decision points to preserve judgment, accountability, and team-level understanding.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The paper envisions reviewers shifting from manual inspectors to supervisory operators of agents.
claims.quote: We propose a future vision for code review in which reviewers transition from manual inspectors into supervisory operators of agents.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: It proposes an AI-powered code review workflow that combines specialized agents with human-controlled quality gates.
claims.quote: We then present a vision for an AI-powered code review workflow combining specialized agents with human-controlled quality gates.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The vision uses staged AI-powered workflows to align the pace of code generation with shared understanding and accountable engineering.
claims.quote: In this vision, staged, AI-powered workflows aim to align the pace of code generation with shared understanding and accountable engineering.
